explication: PCL Community Edition is a Minecraft launcher; the repository contains its launcher modules and a broad shared core. Its user-facing workflow is to configure and manage a Minecraft environment—discover Java, manage profiles and authentication, access game resources, and work with saves—with networking and background tasks supporting those operations. The tree also shows multiplayer, updates, caching, and UI services as distinct capabilities. The README excerpt identifies the product but does not document feature flows; links are limited to relationships supported by sampled source or clear module responsibility.
